name: Cluster LLM control plane (agent :5000 + LiteLLM proxy :4000)
note: Master node's control plane. boot.sh starts the control agent, then has it regenerate litellm/cluster_config.yaml from the instances live across the cluster and (re)start the proxy. Six tools already declare depends_on:["llm-proxy"] — this file is the entry that makes that dependency real; without it topo_order treated the dep as satisfied and nothing ever started the proxy, so an aivm reboot silently took LLM inference down fleet-wide. Model backends live on the GPU boxes (10.2.35.20 / 10.2.35.30) and are never started from aivm; boot-config.json verifies one as a precondition. Do NOT use start_inference_stack.sh (deprecated legacy single-box path).
